verdict.rationale: The skills docs define the format directly: a skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` that must include `name` and `description`, plus optional scripts and references. They also say where skills live (`.agents/skills`), how name and description drive loading, and that a built-in skill creator scaffolds new skills interactively. A community user confirms building their own skills with the skill-creator, and another mentions the YAML frontmatter format. Missing for 10: a literal copy-paste SKILL.md template showing the frontmatter syntax in the evidence, and a documented reference for any optional frontmatter fields beyond name and description.
